Class Tower

java.lang.Object
game.entities.towers.Tower
Direct Known Subclasses:
CidKagenou, Gojo, Ninja, RockThrower, Seal, SniperTower, SplashTower, TackShooter
public abstract class Tower extends Object
Serves as the abstract base for all tower entities, managing universal mechanics like targeting, animation state, and upgrade progression.
